title: XNPV numeric: 1530 of 1530 bit-exact on the production-kernel replay
upstream_status_verbatim: identified by the W109 calculation-graph search, repaired, and signed off `1530/1530` numeric + `175/175` error rows
status_plain: The production XNPV kernel was replayed over every deduplicated answered oracle witness and matched Excel's bits on 1,530 of 1,530 numeric rows. This is the NUMERIC count only. The same sentence publishes 175 of 175 error rows matching #NUM!, which is a guard sweep over rate = 0, rate = -0.0 and every negative rate; that is the structural-admission axis and it is recorded separately in EV-FIN-0009. The two must never be added. Their sum appears in no OxFunc source, and any merged numerator on the numeric axis is fabricated. Held-out status is partial: the validation sweep is described as "discovery + held-out (fresh seed, never searched) + metamorphic pools" plus guard probes, so a held-out component certainly exists, and the source never splits the count.

counts.build_note: Two build statements exist in this document and neither is on the scored line: the section header at line 8, "## Identified calculation graph (live Excel 16.0 build 20131, x86-64)", which governs a different section; and a cache line two bullets below the figure, "(env pinned: Excel 16.0 build 20131, AMD reference host)." at line 69, which describes where the oracle answers are stored. Not inherited.

The 1,854-probe sweep is a different, larger object than the 1,530-row sign-off replay and the two may not be reconciled. corpus_was_repair_target is true because the replay corpus includes the discovery probes the graph was searched on.
